senses.gloss: f. pl. (preced.; cmp. נָעַל a. נַעַל) the net-work of the strappings of sandals (v. Sm. Ant., Engl. ed.3, s. v. Solea).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 60b:5">Sabb. 60ᵇ</cite> (of nails for ornament) <he>שתים … ואחת בתְרֵסִיּוֹתָיו</he> two on each side, and one in the strappings.

<cite ref="Yevamot 102b:3-7">Yeb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא … ותריסיותיו של שיער</he> if the sandal is of leather, and its strappings of hair. Y. ib. XII, 12ᵈ top <he>והן שיהו תרסיותיו של עץ</he> this means, that its strappings are of the vegetable kingdom, v. <cite ref="H00042"><he>חֶבֶט</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:14">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:14">XIII</cite>), 14; Y. ib. VI, 8ᵃ; a. e.—Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 112b:3">ib. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>סנדל שיש לו … וארבע תְּרֵסִיּוֹתִים</he> a sandal which has four loops, and four strapping arrangements.
